text:
ash: Heads-up — AcmeCloud flagged a ~20% mismatch on yesterday's hourly usage batch when comparing our reported billable units to their ingest. They think it's a sample-rate/aggregation mismatch on their SI side. Can someone from metering look? :eyes:

maria: ack, putting this on the partnerships triage. Any repro artifacts from Acme?

ash: They attached a CSV sample and a diff. Quick excerpt they sent:```
timestamp,our_units,partner_units
2026-03-22T10:00Z,120,96
2026-03-22T11:00Z,95,76
```

samir: looks like a 0.8 multiplier — possible downsampling at edge or minute->hour rollup mismatch. Did they say whether partner uses minute-level sampling or a 5-min rollup?

maria: their note: "edge-ambassador client defaults to sample_rate=0.8 for constrained devices" — sounds like device-level sampling. They only noticed because the monthly invoice didn't match expected thresholds.

devin: possible fixes: 1) apply inverse sampler in our reconciliation (ugly), 2) request partner to send raw minute-level counts for disputed windows, or 3) adjust entitlement mapping to use normalized units (preferred long-term).

lia: for short term can we generate a per-hour amplification factor per device id and backfill credits? I can run a rollup job if we have device_id mapping in the CSV.

ash: CSV has device_id anonymized but consistent. Acme agreed to provide raw minute-level for 24-hour window if we sign off on an NDA addendum (they're worried about PII).

samir: we should avoid doing inverse heuristics unless partner explicitly confirms sample_rate. Otherwise we risk over-crediting. Proposal: 1) request raw minute-level for 24h, 2) run side-by-side rollups using our canonical aggregator and partner's sample-rate assumption, 3) compute per-device multiplier and present to partner for signoff.

maria: +1. I'll draft a message to Acme legal & engineering asking for the 24h traces and the ambassador config (sample_rate, rollup window).

billing-bot: Invoice discrepancy alert: partner=acmecloud id=AC-9841 window=2026-03-22 status=open severity=high

devin: operational checklist for the run:```
- ingest partner CSV into staging (s3://redwood-partners/acme/repro/1771239999/)
- run redwood-rollup --window=hour --source=our-agg
- run partner-rollup --sample-rate=0.8 --window=hour
- diff and produce per-device multipliers
```

lia: I can own the staging job, samir can own the rollup scripts. maria will own partner comms. ash will handle mgmt and legal escalation if needed.

ash: timeline? partner wants preliminary numbers before EOD PT. Can we commit?

samir: stg job ~30m, rollups ~45m, diff ~15m — end-to-end ~1.5-2h if no surprises. I'll start now.

maria: drafting comms now, will ask for the raw minute-level + ambassador config and the NDA addendum link.

lia: kicked off: s3 upload in progress (job id: prod-staging-1771239999). I'll post logs when done. :rocket:

ash: thanks team. After we have multipliers we'll propose either credits or entitlement normalization depending on partner preference. Keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
